Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present this two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment located in the sought-after Hampton development in Santry Cross. The property offers bright and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, comprising an entrance hallway, a spacious living and dining area, a fitted kitchen, two generous bedrooms, and two bathrooms, including an en-suite.

Hampton enjoys a superb location in the heart of Santry Cross, with a wide range of local amenities on its doorstep including shops, cafés, restaurants, and gyms. The development benefits from excellent transport links, with frequent bus services and easy access to the M1, M50, Dublin Airport, and Dublin City Centre, making it an ideal home in a highly convenient location.
